reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing shared getRangeAmount/getPlannedAmount helpers, which every schedule consumer (posting, preview, forecast, templates, action sync) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the approximate branch is even simplified to a single expression reusing getApproxNumberThreshold.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the planned-amount rule is already defined; server call sites only get comment updates.

scope.why: Only the helper, its tests, two comments and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean single-point change, though stale 'end furthest from zero' comments remain in forecast-schedules.ts and the preview code in shared/schedules.ts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; the change goes through getRangeAmount/getPlannedAmount
